title: Lessons Stopped Repeating Themselves, Section by Section | vitalii.no
description:
Free-form lesson generation kept producing sections that circled back to the same idea, or drifted away from the word or topic the lesson was supposed to teach, which wasted listening time on content that taught nothing new.

The runner (runner/runner.py) now maps a requested word or topic into a set of distinct aspects up front and assigns exactly one aspect per section. It writes sections in order while passing in the text of every earlier section, so the model cannot repeat a sentence it has already used. For word-focused lessons, the runner checks in code that the target word actually appears often enough, and triggers one automatic rewrite if a section falls short instead of silently shipping thin content.

Generated lessons now visibly cover distinct angles of a topic section by section instead of circling the same point, and a requested word is verifiably present in at least 10 of a section's 16 lines rather than just implied by the title.
